title: द्विचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 42 · The world-guardians give Arjuna weapons

summary.en: As Shiva departs, Yama, Varuna, Kubera and Indra appear on the mountain. Yama gives Arjuna his staff, Varuna his nooses and Kubera his weapon, praising him for having pleased Shiva, and Indra tells him to come to heaven, where he will receive his own weapons.
summary.kn: ಶಿವನು ತೆರಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಯಮ, ವರುಣ, ಕುಬೇರ, ಇಂದ್ರರು ಪರ್ವತದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷರಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಶಿವನನ್ನು ಮೆಚ್ಚಿಸಿದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಗಳುತ್ತಾ ಯಮನು ದಂಡವನ್ನು, ವರುಣನು ಪಾಶಗಳನ್ನು, ಕುಬೇರನು ತನ್ನ ಅಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸ್ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಬಾ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ಅಸ್ತ್ರಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಡುವೆ ಎಂದು ಇಂದ್ರನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शिव के जाते ही यम, वरुण, कुबेर और इन्द्र पर्वत पर प्रकट होते हैं। शिव को प्रसन्न करने के लिए प्रशंसा करते हुए यम अपना दण्ड, वरुण अपने पाश और कुबेर अपना अस्त्र देते हैं, और इन्द्र उन्हें स्वर्ग आने को कहते हैं जहाँ वे अपने अस्त्र देंगे।
summary.te: శివుడు వెళ్తుండగా యముడు, వరుణుడు, కుబేరుడు, ఇంద్రుడు పర్వతంపై ప్రత్యక్షమవుతారు. శివుని ప్రసన్నం చేసుకున్నందుకు కొనియాడుతూ యముడు దండాన్ని, వరుణుడు పాశాలను, కుబేరుడు తన అస్త్రాన్ని ఇస్తారు; స్వర్గానికి రమ్మని, అక్కడ తన అస్త్రాలు ఇస్తానని ఇంద్రుడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: ஶிவன் புறப்படும்போது யமன், வருணன், குபேரன், இந்திரன் மலையில் தோன்றுகிறார்கள். ஶிவனை மகிழ்வித்ததற்காகப் புகழ்ந்து யமன் தன் தண்டத்தையும், வருணன் தன் பாசங்களையும், குபேரன் தன் அஸ்திரத்தையும் அளிக்க, ஸ்வர்க்கத்துக்கு வா, அங்கு தன் அஸ்திரங்களைத் தருவேன் என்று இந்திரன் சொல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: ശിവൻ പോകുമ്പോൾ യമൻ, വരുണൻ, കുബേരൻ, ഇന്ദ്രൻ എന്നിവർ മലയിൽ പ്രത്യക്ഷരാകുന്നു. യമൻ തന്റെ ദണ്ഡും വരുണൻ പാശങ്ങളും കുബേരൻ തന്റെ ആയുധവും അർജുനന് നൽകുന്നു; ശിവനെ പ്രീതിപ്പെടുത്തിയതിന് അവർ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ പ്രശംസിക്കുന്നു. സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിൽ വന്നാൽ സ്വന്തം ആയുധങ്ങൾ ലഭിക്കുമെന്ന് ഇന്ദ്രൻ പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.42; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तस्य संपश्यतस्त्वेव पिनाकी वृषभध्वजः ।
जगामादर्शनं भानुर्लोकस्येवास्तमेयिवान् ॥

meaning.en: While Arjuna was still looking, Pinakin, the bull-bannered god, vanished from sight like the sun setting for the world.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनः परं चक्रे विस्मयं परवीरहा ।
मया साक्षान्महादेवो दृष्ट इत्येव भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna, slayer of enemy heroes, was filled with great wonder: "I have seen Mahadeva himself."

verses.text:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यन्मया त्र्यम्बको हरः ।
पिनाकी वरदो रूपी दृष्टः स्पृष्टश्च पाणिना ॥

meaning.en: "I am blessed and favored, for I have seen the boon-giving Tryambaka Hara, the bearer of Pinaka, in visible form and touched him with my hand."

verses.text:
कृतार्थं चावगच्छामि परमात्मानमात्मना ।
शत्रूंश्च विजितान्सर्वान्निर्वृत्तं च प्रयोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: "I count myself as having fulfilled my purpose by my own self, the supreme Self; all my enemies are conquered and my aim is accomplished."

verses.text:
ततो वैडूर्यवर्णाभो भासयन्सर्वतो दिशः ।
यादोगणवृतः श्रीमानाजगाम जलेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then the glorious lord of waters, shining with the color of lapis lazuli and lighting all directions, came, surrounded by hosts of water creatures.

verses.text:
नागैर्नदैर्नदीभिश्च दैत्यैः साध्यैश्च दैवतैः ।
वरुणो यादसां भर्ता वशी तं देशमागमत् ॥

meaning.en: Varuna, lord of aquatic beings and self-controlled, came to that place with nagas, rivers, streams, daityas, sadhyas and gods.

verses.text:
अथ जाम्बूनदवपुर्विमानेन महार्चिषा ।
कुबेरः समनुप्राप्तो यक्षैरनुगतः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Kubera, the lord, came in a splendid golden-bodied aircraft blazing greatly, followed by yakshas.

verses.text:
विद्योतयन्निवाकाशमद्भुतोपमदर्शनः ।
धनानामीश्वरः श्रीमानर्जुनं द्रष्टुमागतः ॥

meaning.en: Lighting up the sky with a wondrous appearance, the lord of wealth came to see Arjuna.

verses.text:
तथा लोकान्तकृच्छ्रीमान्यमः साक्षात्प्रतापवान् ।
मूर्त्यमूर्तिधरैः सार्धं पितृभिर्लोकभावनैः ॥

meaning.en: So too came glorious and mighty Yama himself, the ender of the worlds, with the ancestors who sustain the worlds, some embodied and some not.

verses.text:
दण्डपाणिरचिन्त्यात्मा सर्वभूतविनाशकृत् ।
वैवस्वतो धर्मराजो विमानेनावभासयन् ॥

meaning.en: Rod in hand, of inconceivable nature, destroyer of all beings, Vaivasvata, the king of dharma, lit up in his aircraft

verses.text:
त्रीँल्लोकान्गुह्यकांश्चैव गन्धर्वांश्च सपन्नगान् ।
द्वितीय इव मार्तण्डो युगान्ते समुपस्थिते ॥

meaning.en: the three worlds with the guhyakas, gandharvas and serpents, like a second sun when the age is ending.

verses.text:
भानुमन्ति विचित्राणि शिखराणि महागिरेः ।
समास्थायार्जुनं तत्र ददृशुस्तपसान्वितम् ॥

meaning.en: Standing on the radiant, wondrous peaks of the great mountain, they saw Arjuna joined to austerity.

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्ताद्भगवानैरावतशिरोगतः ।
आजगाम सहेन्द्राण्या शक्रः सुरगणैर्वृतः ॥

meaning.en: Then, after a moment, the blessed Shakra came, seated on Airavata's head, with Indrani, surrounded by hosts of gods.

verses.text:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि ।
शुशुभे तारकाराजः सितमभ्रमिवास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: With a white umbrella held over his head he shone like the moon among the stars, standing like a white cloud.

verses.text:
संस्तूयमानो गन्धर्वैरृषिभिश्च तपोधनैः ।
शृङ्गं गिरेः समासाद्य तस्थौ सूर्य इवोदितः ॥

meaning.en: Praised by gandharvas and by sages rich in austerity, he reached the mountain peak and stood like the risen sun.

verses.text:
अथ मेघस्वनो धीमान्व्याजहार शुभां गिरम् ।
यमः परमधर्मज्ञो दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Then the wise Yama, voice like thunder, who knows supreme dharma and stood in the southern quarter, spoke these good words:

verses.text:
अर्जुनार्जुन पश्यास्माँल्लोकपालान्समागतान् ।
दृष्टिं ते वितरामोऽद्य भवानर्हो हि दर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Arjuna, Arjuna, see us, the world-guardians who have come together. We give you vision today; you deserve to see us."

verses.text:
पूर्वर्षिरमितात्मा त्वं नरो नाम महाबलः ।
नियोगाद्ब्रह्मणस्तात मर्त्यतां समुपागतः ।
त्वं वासवसमुद्भूतो महावीर्यपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: "You were a sage of old, of immeasurable spirit, named Nara, of great strength; at Brahma's command, dear, you came to mortality. You are born from Vasava, of great vigor and valor."

verses.text:
क्षत्रं चाग्निसमस्पर्शं भारद्वाजेन रक्षितम् ।
दानवाश्च महावीर्या ये मनुष्यत्वमागताः ।
निवातकवचाश्चैव संसाध्याः कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: "The warrior class, whose touch is like fire, is protected by Bharadvaja's son. The mighty danavas who have come as humans, and the Nivatakavachas, must be subdued by you, delight of the Kurus."

verses.text:
पितुर्ममांशो देवस्य सर्वलोकप्रतापिनः ।
कर्णः स सुमहावीर्यस्त्वया वध्यो धनंजय ॥

meaning.en: "Karna, of very great might, is a part of my father, the god who gives heat to all the worlds; he is to be slain by you, Dhananjaya."

verses.text:
अंशाश्च क्षितिसंप्राप्ता देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् ।
तया निपातिता युद्धे स्वकर्मफलनिर्जिताम् ।
गतिं प्राप्स्यन्ति कौन्तेय यथास्वमरिकर्शन ॥

meaning.en: "Parts of gods, gandharvas and rakshasas who have come to earth, struck down by you in battle, will reach destinations fitting each, scourge of foes, as conquered by the fruit of their own deeds."

verses.text:
अक्षया तव कीर्तिश्च लोके स्थास्यति फल्गुन ।
त्वया साक्षान्महादेवस्तोषितो हि महामृधे ।
लघ्वी वसुमती चापि कर्तव्या विष्णुना सह ॥

meaning.en: "Your fame will stand imperishable in the world, Phalguna; for you have pleased Mahadeva himself in a great battle, and with Vishnu you are to lighten the earth."

verses.text:
गृहाणास्त्रं महाबाहो दण्डमप्रतिवारणम् ।
अनेनास्त्रेण सुमहत्त्वं हि कर्म करिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "Take this weapon, mighty-armed one, the rod that cannot be turned aside; with this weapon you will do a very great deed."

verses.text:
प्रतिजग्राह तत्पार्थो विधिवत्कुरुनन्दनः ।
समन्त्रं सोपचारं च समोक्षं सनिवर्तनम् ॥

meaning.en: That Partha, delight of the Kurus, received it as prescribed, with its mantra, rites, release and withdrawal.

verses.text:
ततो जलधरश्यामो वरुणो यादसां पतिः ।
पश्चिमां दिशमास्थाय गिरमुच्चारयन्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Then Varuna, lord of aquatic beings, dark as a rain cloud, standing in the western quarter, spoke:

verses.text:
पार्थ क्षत्रियमुख्यस्त्वं क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितः ।
पश्य मां पृथुताम्राक्ष वरुणोऽस्मि जलेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: "Partha, you are chief of warriors and established in the warrior's duty. Look at me, broad-copper-eyed one, I am Varuna, lord of waters."

verses.text:
मया समुद्यतान्पाशान्वारुणाननिवारणान् ।
प्रतिगृह्णीष्व कौन्तेय सरहस्यनिवर्तनान् ॥

meaning.en: "Take the Varuna nooses, which I raise and which cannot be resisted, with their secret and their withdrawal, son of Kunti."

verses.text:
एभिस्तदा मया वीर संग्रामे तारकामये ।
दैतेयानां सहस्राणि संयतानि महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "With these, hero, in the battle named after Taraka, I bound thousands of great Daitya warriors."

verses.text:
तस्मादिमान्महासत्त्व मत्प्रसादात्समुत्थितान् ।
गृहाण न हि ते मुच्येदन्तकोऽप्याततायिनः ॥

meaning.en: "So take these, great-spirited one, arisen by my favor; not even Death could escape them if you used them on a deadly attacker."

verses.text:
अनेन त्वं यदास्त्रेण संग्रामे विचरिष्यसि ।
तदा निःक्षत्रिया भूमिर्भविष्यति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: "When you move in battle with this weapon, the earth will be without warriors, without doubt."

verses.text:
ततः कैलासनिलयो धनाध्यक्षोऽभ्यभाषत ।
दत्तेष्वस्त्रेषु दिव्येषु वरुणेन यमेन च ॥

meaning.en: Then the lord of wealth, who dwells on Kailasa, spoke, when the divine weapons had been given by Varuna and Yama:

verses.text:
सव्यसाचिन्महाबाहो पूर्वदेव सनातन ।
सहास्माभिर्भवाञ्श्रान्तः पुराकल्पेषु नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: "Savyasachi, mighty-armed, ancient god, eternal one, you have always toiled with us in earlier ages."

verses.text:
मत्तोऽपि त्वं गृहाणास्त्रमन्तर्धानं प्रियं मम ।
ओजस्तेजोद्युतिहरं प्रस्वापनमरातिहन् ॥

meaning.en: "Take from me too the weapon called Antardhana, dear to me, which takes away strength, brilliance and luster, and puts to sleep, slayer of foes."

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनो महाबाहुर्विधिवत्कुरुनन्दनः ।
कौबेरमपि जग्राह दिव्यमस्त्रं महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Then the mighty-armed delight of the Kurus, strong Arjuna, duly received the divine weapon of Kubera as well.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीद्देवराजः पार्थमक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।
सान्त्वयञ्श्लक्ष्णया वाचा मेघदुन्दुभिनिस्वनः ॥

meaning.en: Then the king of the gods, whose voice is like a cloud-drum, spoke to Partha, whose deeds are effortless, consoling him with gentle words:

verses.text:
कुन्तीमातर्महाबाहो त्वमीशानः पुरातनः ।
परां सिद्धिमनुप्राप्तः साक्षाद्देवगतिं गतः ॥

meaning.en: "Mighty-armed son of Kunti, you are the ancient lord and have attained the highest perfection, going to the very goal of the gods."

verses.text:
देवकार्यं हि सुमहत्त्वया कार्यमरिंदम ।
आरोढव्यस्त्वया स्वर्गः सज्जीभव महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: "You must do a very great task for the gods, scourge of enemies; you must ascend to heaven; get ready, radiant one."

verses.text:
रथो मातलिसंयुक्त आगन्ता त्वत्कृते महीम् ।
तत्र तेऽहं प्रदास्यामि दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि कौरव ॥

meaning.en: "A chariot yoked with Matali will come to earth for you; there I will give you the divine weapons, Kaurava."

verses.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा लोकपालांस्तु समेतान्गिरिमूर्धनि ।
जगाम विस्मयं धीमान्कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those world-guardians gathered on the mountain top, wise Dhananjaya, son of Kunti, was filled with wonder.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनो महातेजा लोकपालान्समागतान् ।
पूजयामास विधिवद्वाग्भिरद्भिः फलैरपि ॥

meaning.en: Then the very radiant Arjuna honored the gathered world-guardians duly with words, water and fruits.

verses.text:
ततः प्रतिययुर्देवाः प्रतिपूज्य धनंजयम् ।
यथागतेन विबुधाः सर्वे काममनोजवाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods, having honored Dhananjaya in return, all went back, swift as thought, the way they had come.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनो मुदं लेभे लब्धास्त्रः पुरुषर्षभः ।
कृतार्थमिव चात्मानं स मेने पूर्णमानसः ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna, bull among men, having gained the weapons, was glad, and with a full heart felt that his purpose was fulfilled.
